title: Jeimer Candelario 2024 Topps Update #US142 Halloween Holiday Parallel Reds
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This is a 2024 Topps Update trading card featuring Jeimer Candelario of the Cincinnati Reds. The card is a Halloween Holiday Parallel variety, with a card number of US142. It is made of 35 Pt. card stock material and is an original print from the manufacturer, Topps. 

The card is a standard size and is in English language. It is a Major League Baseball (MLB) trading card, perfect for collectors and fans of the sport. The card is not autographed and is not a vintage or licensed reprint. The set is from the 2024 season and is a great addition to any sports trading card collection.
